scope: Independent free-product normal-form, torsion, triangular-presentation, finite-index-image, and property-(T)-transfer audit
strongest_verified_claim: For every admissible fixed alphabet with at least three factors and L>=4, the candidate triangular group maps onto a subgroup of index at most two in the random quotient. Property (T) of the former therefore implies property (T) of the full quotient.
assumptions: Finite nonempty inverse-closed generating subset in each factor, consisting of actual nonidentity elements
Factors and alphabets fixed before relator length varies
Candidate triangular group has property (T), supplied by separately audited spectral/probability argument
boundaries: No two-factor conclusion; explicit C2*C2 failure of the deterministic <=2 lemma
No uniformity in changing alphabets, factors, or density
No claim at d=1/3 or for all small lengths
No assertion that factor images embed, retain abelianization, or are finitely presented
separate_obligations: Complete exact external concentration/source and target-model audit
